headword: {一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし}
reading: いっきゅうけんちくし

definitions.explanation: The highest level of architect certification in Japan, issued by the national government. Holders are qualified to design buildings of any size, including large commercial, industrial, and public structures.

examples.japanese: 彼女は{一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし}だ。
examples.english: She is a first-class licensed architect.

examples.japanese: {一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし}の{試験|しけん}は{難関|なんかん}で{知|し}られている。
examples.english: The first-class architect exam is known to be difficult.

examples.japanese: その{設計事務所|せっけいじむしょ}では、すべてのスタッフが{一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし}の{資格|しかく}を{持|も}っている。
examples.english: All the staff at that architectural firm hold first-class architect qualifications.

notes:
Japan's architect licensing system has two levels: 一級建築士 (first class, national license) and {二級建築士|にきゅうけんちくし} (second class, prefectural license). Only 一級建築士 can design large-scale buildings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし}{試験|しけん}: first-class architect examination
- {一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし}{事務所|じむしょ}: first-class architect firm
- {一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし}{免許|めんきょ}: first-class architect license
- {一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし}{資格|しかく}: first-class architect qualification
